name: web-scroll-hero-with-photographed-space-airlock-and-white-caps-title
title: Full-bleed photo of a space-station airlock hatch with a white caps title 'THE AIRLOCK OPENS' and a small scroll cue
whatItIs: A symmetrical photograph of a grey space-station module with a large round hatch at the centre, yellow handrails and warning labels, and a bold white caps title 'THE AIRLOCK OPENS' across the middle with a tiny 'SCROLL' marker at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Dramatic and cinematic; the hatch sets up a reveal as the user scrolls.
techniques: Place a bold title over the focal object.
Use the image as a scroll-triggered opening.

vocabulary.definition: A hero composed around a centre axis.
A central object drawing the eye.
